items.title: 2.6.1.4 Methods and Operations on Lists (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list methods (PDF 51-52).

blocks.text: Lists ke saath kaam ke liye Python kai built-in methods (list ke apne functions) deti hai. Kuch kaam ke methods yeh hain:

items: append(item): item ko list ke aakhir mein jorta hai.
remove(item): list mein woh item jahan sab se pehle aata hai (first occurrence), usay hata deta hai.
sort(): list ko ascending order (chhote se bare ki tarteeb) mein laga deta hai.
reverse(): list ka order ulat deta hai.

blocks.text: Misaal: students ki list mein naya student jorein aur phir list ko sort karein (tarteeb mein lagayein).
Wazahat: code students ki list banata hai, us mein 'Hina' jorta hai aur phir alphabet ke hisaab se sort karta hai: ['Ahmed', 'Ali', 'Hina', 'Sara'].

blocks.prompt: sort ke baad students.reverse() kya deta hai?

items: append, remove, sort, reverse: list ke aam methods.
